crossRefs.note: Nathan said to David, “You are the man. This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel…
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse…
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body, and shed out his…
Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

translations.web: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
translations.bsb: The wounds of a friend are faithful, but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
translations.kjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
translations.asv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; But the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
